lines: You have an idea but can't see the architecture. Archify turns your code into a clear diagram instantly.
Archify turns any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
The agent generates a typed JSON model, validates it against rules, then renders the interactive diagram.
Use Archify to diagram a web request: Browser calls the API, the API checks Redis, and a cache miss queries PostgreSQL and fills the cache.
Open the Proof Lab to see all 11 checked-in scenarios, their JSON sources, and validation receipts.
The output is a standalone HTML file. You can download it and open it in any browser.
You can preview themes like dark or light mode, then export PNG to your clipboard directly.
Build trust: MIT licensed, used by many developers.
Install Archify with this command to generate your diagram. npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g
Send this to someone who builds with Claude Code or Codex.
Get the standalone HTML file from your description.
